claim_scope: The Tau ADT/table research workflow is exact-source-bound to the reviewed Tau and Taumorrow demo commits, replays the basic/advanced/beyond-SQL baselines, fails closed on upstream Tau diagnostics, uses bounded build parallelism/timeouts, runs the ZenoDEX table contracts, and retains replay receipts.
failure_modes: workflow silently tracks mutable Tau main instead of an exact reviewed commit
workflow silently tracks mutable demo main instead of an exact reviewed commit
workflow omits the beyond-SQL table baseline while claiming current table semantics
workflow ignores Tau diagnostics from the beyond-SQL baseline
workflow increases Tau build parallelism beyond the bounded hosted-runner setting
workflow shrinks table-demo timeouts below the tested boundary and converts slow valid replays into false failures
workflow stops running the ZenoDEX table contract runner or stops retaining its receipts

aaa.reason: Each regression arranges the exact workflow text, applies one mutation or boundary change, then asserts the workflow contract either accepts the current configuration or rejects the unsafe variant.

reject_is_noop.reason: This packet governs CI assurance infrastructure rather than a state transition.

mutations.description: replace the exact Tau commit with mutable main
remove the exact Tau HEAD equality assertion
replace the exact Taumorrow demo commit with mutable main
drop the beyond-SQL baseline by rebinding it to the advanced demo
raise Tau build parallelism from two jobs to eight
shrink the beyond-SQL replay timeout from 180 seconds to 30 seconds

nonclaims: This packet does not prove the ZenoDEX Tau table contracts semantically correct; the tau-adt-table-lab workflow must earn those verdicts separately.
This packet does not grant settlement, governance, verifier, migration, release, publication, or value-moving authority.
This packet does not establish Tau table scalability, mutable SQL semantics, production Tau Net compatibility, or host arithmetic/hash/signature correctness.
